const item = $input.first().json;
const allUrls = JSON.parse(item.all_video_urls || '[]');

return [{ json: {
  source_url: String(item.source_url || ''),
  video_title: String(item.title || ''),
  status: 'completed_' + allUrls.length + '_clips',
  global_style: String(item.global_style || ''),
  character_description: String(item.character_description || ''),
  clip_1_url: String(allUrls[0] || ''),
  clip_2_url: String(allUrls[1] || ''),
  clip_3_url: String(allUrls[2] || ''),
  clip_4_url: String(allUrls[3] || ''),
  all_video_urls: allUrls.join(' | '),
  total_duration_estimate: allUrls.length * (item.clip_duration || 10) + 's',
  debug_method: String(item.debug_method || ''),
  debug_details: String(item.debug_details || ''),
  completed_at: new Date().toISOString(),
  error: ''
} }];

const item = $input.first().json;
const allUrls = JSON.parse(item.all_video_urls || '[]');

return [{ json: {
  source_url: String(item.source_url || ''),
  video_title: String(item.title || ''),
  status: String(item.task_status === 'failed' ? 'failed_at_clip_' + ((item.current_clip || 0) + 1) : 'timeout_at_clip_' + ((item.current_clip || 0) + 1)),
  global_style: String(item.global_style || ''),
  character_description: String(item.character_description || ''),
  clip_1_url: String(allUrls[0] || ''),
  clip_2_url: String(allUrls[1] || ''),
  clip_3_url: String(allUrls[2] || ''),
  clip_4_url: String(allUrls[3] || ''),
  all_video_urls: allUrls.join(' | '),
  total_duration_estimate: allUrls.length * (item.clip_duration || 10) + 's',
  debug_method: String(item.debug_method || ''),
  debug_details: String(item.debug_details || ''),
  completed_at: new Date().toISOString(),
  error: String(item.raw_status || 'Timeout or failed')
} }];

const item = $input.first().json;
return [{ json: {
  source_url: String(item.source_url || ''),
  video_title: String(item.title || ''),
  status: String(item.status || 'submit_failed'),
  global_style: '',
  character_description: '',
  clip_1_url: '',
  clip_2_url: '',
  clip_3_url: '',
  clip_4_url: '',
  all_video_urls: '',
  total_duration: '0s',
  debug_method: String(item.debug_method || ''),
  completed_at: new Date().toISOString(),
  error: String(item.error || 'Seedance API submit failed - check API key and model activation')
} }];
